summary: Linear lookup over five two-dword setup-param records on the receiver, starting at element 4177 (byte offset 0x4144). Scans the first dword of each record for the key a2, stepping two elements per record; on a match returns the paired second dword (element 2*v2 + 4178), or -1 after five records with no match. Read-only; no globals or callees. Called by AICollision (0x004BEF60).

local_names.this: receiver holding the five two-dword setup-param records
local_names.a2: key matched against the first dword of each record
local_names.i: scanning dword pointer advancing by two elements per record

operations.description: Seed the record index v2 to 0 before the scan
Scan up to five records: pointer i starts at this + 4177 (byte offset 0x4144) and advances by two dwords per iteration
Exit the loop when the first dword of the current record (*i) equals the key a2
After incrementing v2, if v2 reaches 5 the key was not found and the function returns -1
On a match return the paired second dword of the matched record, element 2*v2 + 4178
Invoked by AICollision (0x004BEF60) to resolve a setup parameter from a keyed id

unresolved: The meaning of the key a2 and of the returned paired value is caller-dependent; AICollision (0x004BEF60) is the only known caller
Only the record start field (this+0x4144) is evidenced; the receiver type is not identified
The paired element 2*v2 + 4178 (byte offset 0x4148 onward) is not listed as a separate field in packet facts
